name: Counterexample Preservation and Boundary Mapping
purpose: Collect counterexamples and failure cases from MT-001/002/003 candidate review as formal boundary information.

counterexample_map.boundary_condition: neighborhood instability or recursive depth limit exceeded
excessive neighborhood flux or orientation locking
mismatch resolution floor exceeded or constraint locking

governance_rules.rule: Counterexamples are structural boundary information, not defects to erase.
Every active counterexample must be explicitly mapped to its affected theorem candidate.

forbidden_claims: Counterexample preservation is a sign of framework failure.
Mapping failure cases derives physical chaos laws.
Boundaries can be 'assumed away' if they are inconvenient for a proof.
